expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Version 2 will expand the current ping-only message protocol with additional message types, more robust decoding and validation, and a clear compatibility path for existing clients; the work will also improve error reporting and establish a stable foundation for future protocol extensions.
Version 2 Hello support is shipped with the explicit `v:2:hello:<name>` envelope.
